tx: 0:00 0 seconds This man has been walking for 27 years to become the only person in history to walk around the entire planet with just | 0:07 7 seconds one rule. No transport of any kind. Carl Bushby began his journey in 1998 from the southern edge of Chile saying, "I'll | 0:15 15 seconds return home only on foot." After 2 years, he had crossed all of South America and faced his first major obstacle, the Darian Gap, one of the | 0:24 24 seconds deadliest places on Earth with its impenetrable jungle, smugglers, and armed clashes between rebels and the military. As part of a group, Carl spent | 0:32 32 seconds 50 days avoiding danger and somehow made it out alive. Panameanian soldiers even held him for 18 days before letting him | 0:39 39 seconds continue his trek. It took 6 years to cross all of Central and North America and reach the Bearing Straight, which separates the two continents. After | 0:47 47 seconds waiting for the straight to freeze, he and French traveler Dmitri Kefir became one of the first ever to cross it on foot despite drifting 80 km off course. | 0:56 56 seconds Then he faced arrest in Russia and strict visa limits, which forced him to leave the route every 90 days and return to the exact same spot to continue his | 1:04 1 minute, 4 seconds journey. As a result, his trek across Siberia, where temperatures dropped to minus50, stretched over 11 long years. | 1:11 1 minute, 11 seconds When the world shut down during the pandemic and borders closed, Carl was stuck in Kazakhstan for 4 years and hit a dead end, the Caspian Sea. He couldn't | 1:19 1 minute, 19 seconds go around it through Russia or Iran. So, he made one choice, to swim across. | 1:23 1 minute, 23 seconds Using a support boat only for rest and sleep, he and American traveler Angela Maxwell crossed the Caspian Sea in 30 days, becoming the only people ever to | 1:31 1 minute, 31 seconds do so. After nearly three decades, 25 countries, and 47,000 kilometers, Carl is now walking across Europe and is expected to finally return home by 2026.
